description: Reference routine: slow jumping jacks, tennis swings, squats, then look left and right.

devices.phone: right front pocket, screen toward leg

window_source: Times are seconds after Start. No trial markers were pressed; windows were set by hand from the Watch rotation rate, phone thigh inclination and AirPods yaw (see EXPERIMENT_LOG.md, 2026-10-08).

activities.name: standing_still
activities.note: Right after the calibration hold, arms hanging at the sides. A hanging arm puts the wrist about 0.05 m below the pelvis joint.

activities.name: jumping_jacks
activities.note: Slow motion. The model shows 4 arm raises: a partial one near 21.5 s, then 3 full.

activities.name: tennis_swings
activities.note: Right arm (Watch arm). Torso and head rotate with each swing.

activities.name: head_turns
activities.note: One look left, one look right.
